features.label: Toughness
features.description: Hard living has thickened your hide. Your maximum hit points increase each time you take this perk.

features.label: Alert
features.description: You are hard to catch off guard, gaining a sizeable edge on initiative and immunity to being surprised.

features.label: Power Attack
features.description: You put your whole body behind each swing, dealing extra melee damage.

features.label: Deadeye
features.description: Your aim finds the gaps. Ranged attacks (with bows, crossbows, guns, or throwing weapons) land critical hits more often.

features.label: Shield Wall
features.description: You turn a shield into a fortress, blocking a greater share of incoming damage.

features.label: Pyromancer
features.description: Flame answers your call more fiercely, increasing the damage of Red Magic.

effects.description: +15% Red Magic effect magnitude per rank

features.label: Ghost
features.description: You move like a shadow, far harder to detect while sneaking.

effects.description: -25% chance to be detected while sneaking

features.label: Silver Tongue
features.description: Your words open doors and purses alike, improving persuasion and barter prices.

features.label: Field Medic
features.description: Your mundane healing is markedly more effective.

features.label: Gifted
features.description: You are exceptionally talented, but lean on raw aptitude over study. Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Fast Shot
features.description: You attack quickly but recklessly. Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Small Frame
features.description: You are slight of build: nimble, but you cannot carry as much. Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Genius
features.description: A quick study with room for one more focus, at the cost of breadth. Chosen at character creation.

features.label: Undead Phobia
features.description: The walking dead fill you with primal terror. Skeletons, zombies, and wraiths shake your resolve.

effects.description: Significant combat penalties against the undead
Reduces damage and effects from undead

features.label: Beast Phobia
features.description: You have a deep fear of wild beasts and monstrous animals. Fighting them is a nightmare.

effects.description: Combat and survival penalties when fighting beasts

features.label: Leather Allergy
features.description: You suffer painful rashes and breathing difficulty from leather and animal hides. Most common light armor is off-limits.

effects.description: Cannot equip or benefit from leather/hide items
Improved defense and comfort in metal armor

features.label: Iron Allergy
features.description: Common iron and steel burn your flesh and interfere with your magic. You must seek rarer materials.

effects.description: Reduced effectiveness with iron or steel weapons and armor
Affinity with exotic materials (silver, elven wood, etc.)

features.label: Silver Sensitivity
features.description: Silver weapons and objects are toxic to your body. You avoid them at all costs.

effects.description: Extra damage from silver; cannot benefit from silver equipment
Strong resistance to undead and unholy effects
Chance to absorb incoming hostile magic as mana

features.label: Arcane Phobia
features.description: Magic and magically-created beings (constructs, golems, summoned creatures) terrify you.

effects.description: Reduced effectiveness against constructs and magically animated beings
Chance to absorb a portion of incoming spell damage as mana

features.label: Heavy Armor Expert
features.description: You have trained extensively in heavy plate. The stamina and AP surcharges for demanding actions are halved (×1.5 instead of ×2.0 for dodge, etc.).

effects.description: Halve heavy armor action cost surcharges

features.label: Light Foot
features.description: You move with grace even in medium armor. All medium armor stamina and AP surcharges on movement and dodging are eliminated.

effects.description: Ignore medium armor action cost surcharges

features.label: Brutal Charge
features.description: You barrel through enemies in heavy armor. Power attacks and charges cost stamina equal to a light attack — the heavy surcharge is negated.

effects.description: Power attacks in heavy armor cost light attack stamina (no heavy surcharge)

features.label: Acrobat
features.description: You are exceptionally nimble and coordinated. Dodge rolls cost 25% less stamina, and you recover from knockdowns faster.
